queue.title: Por que o mercado continua a dormir sobre o potencial de crescimento da Micron
queue.resumo: A Micron continua a apresentar resultados sólidos, o que sugere que o mercado pode estar subestimando seu potencial de crescimento.

queue.title: Ukrainian Drone With Huge Explosive Payload Hits Bulgaria Near Vital Gas Pipeline
queue.resumo: Ukrainian Drone With Huge Explosive Payload Hits Bulgaria Near Vital Gas Pipeline A major border and aerial incident has occurred between Ukraine and Bulgaria, and Bulgarian officials are outraged and demanding answers - ironically on the heels of a political shift regarding the Ukraine war wherein Sofia has stopped giving weaponry, citing its own stockpile shortages. A Ukrainian drone on Saturday breached Bulgaria's airspace and directly endangered vital energy infrastructure upon exploding in Bulgarian territory, regional media reports.
